Monitor your tracking link for updates, as scans may appear after the package reaches the carrier terminal.

If your tracking shows "delivered" but you haven't received your package, here are some steps you can take:
Check the delivery confirmation email for details or photos of the delivery location. Sometimes packages are left in secure or unexpected places, such as mailrooms, porches, or sheds.
Ask neighbors or building staff if the package was delivered nearby by mistake.
If your order included multiple items, some may still be in transit. Review the tracking details for each item to confirm their status.
If you still cannot locate your package after these steps, confirm your shipping address and request a delivery investigation. If the package is determined to be missing or stolen, you may be eligible for a replacement or refund, depending on the outcome of the investigation.
